note: Tile services snapshot.py may copy into a project. cache 'allowed' means the provider's terms permit storing tiles for offline rendering within the stated license; 'forbidden' entries are listed so a request fails with the reason instead of silently scraping.

aws-terrarium.name: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data)
aws-terrarium.license: Open data; component sources keep their own terms (SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, NED and others)
aws-terrarium.attribution: Terrain Tiles by Mapzen via AWS Open Data. SRTM, GMTED2010 and 3DEP courtesy of USGS. ETOPO1 by NOAA. Regional source credits: https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md

eox-s2cloudless-2016.name: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 (EOX)
eox-s2cloudless-2016.attribution: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016 & 2017)

osm-standard.name: OpenStreetMap standard tiles
osm-standard.reason: OSMF tile usage policy forbids bulk downloading; snapshot open vector data and style it instead

esri-world-imagery.name: Esri World Imagery
esri-world-imagery.reason: Esri terms do not permit storing tiles for offline use without a licence

google-satellite.name: Google Maps satellite
google-satellite.reason: Google Maps Platform terms prohibit caching or bulk download of tiles
